subject.title: fix(security): add default pidsLimit for sandbox containers

question: Should OpenClaw make 1024 the default Docker sandbox PID limit for existing configs, and what explicit opt-out or migration contract should ship with it?
rationale: The code change is small, but it intentionally changes a security/resource default for existing sandbox users and the current schema/docs do not provide a clean validated opt-out.

options.title: Approve default with opt-out
options.body: Keep 1024 as the secure default, but require schema/docs/tests/proof that explicit override and unlimited behavior are available by an approved contract.

options.title: Document opt-in only
options.body: Leave unset configs unchanged and instead improve docs/doctor guidance for operators who want a PID cap.

options.title: Choose a different resource policy
options.body: Pause this PR until secops selects a broader CPU, memory, and PID default policy.

recommendation.title: Approve default with opt-out
recommendation.body: Keep 1024 as the secure default, but require schema/docs/tests/proof that explicit override and unlimited behavior are available by an approved contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent sandbox resource-limit and security-hardening history makes this the strongest individual routing candidate from the inspected history.
